full_text:
Clease is an elderly Huntik Foundation operative based at Huntik Foundation Italian HQ in Venice. He holds the job of monitoring and training new Seekers.

== History ==
Clease witnessed Simon Judeau shouting at Eathon Lambert to be his dog. He gave Eathon his word that he would never tell a soul. [The Secret of Two Generations]

Clease decided to tell Lok of this since he was his son and wanted to help him find out more. However, on the way home Clease was ambushed by The Professor and his two Suits. Clease was temporarily put under the control by Araknos's 'Mastermind' power. He was used to enter Dante's house and disable the magical protective barrier around it. [The Secret of Two Generations]

Clease was present when Klaus was turned back from stone by King Basilisk. [ The Blood Spiral]

Clease was trying to train and monitor a bored Den and got buried under a pile of books after an accident in the library.[Boys Will Be Seekers]

== Abilities ==
Clease is an elderly but knowledgable Seeker whose expertise lies in the teaching of Seekers using academic books and tomes.

===Spells Utilized===

* Venomhand (under
the Professor's control)
